description: Construct-coverage allowlist for constructcheck/run.js. DENY BY DEFAULT: a key in `allow` means a human has verified that construct converts correctly on a real migrated page (source AsciiDoc -> MDX). Keys are `category:token` exactly as the gate reports them. Add a key only after checking the construct on the page(s) the gate cites. `notes` is a sibling map (key -> one-line evidence for why it was trusted); the gate ignores it, it is the audit trail.

notes.conditional:endif::: closes an ifdef/ifndef/ifeval; here the </IfSnapshot> boundary. Same handling as conditional:ifdef::snapshot.
notes.conditional:ifdef::snapshot: operator-only. ifdef::snapshot[]..endif -> <IfSnapshot> component (src/components/IfSnapshot.tsx), which renders children only when useDocsVersion().banner==='unreleased' (latest-snapshot). Version-cut-safe, no per-version baking. ACCEPTED DIVERGENCE (user decision 2026-08-11): released branches v/5.17 + v/5.18 carry a STRAY `snapshot: true` in antora.yml (release-cut left it behind; 5.16 & older are clean), so production/golden SHOW the snapshot note on 5.17/5.18 while the migrated site hides it. The migrated behaviour is more correct (the note 'no Red Hat images for snapshot versions' is wrong on a release). This is the sole cause of the 2 image-registry fidelity failures; accepted + documented, NOT baked to match the buggy source. See docusaurus-conditionals-project.
notes.conditional:ifndef::snapshot: management-center-only (clusters/update-config.adoc:30, getting-started/install.adoc). The ELSE half of the pair -- the shape 38 of 41 live `ifdef`s use -- and the counterpart to conditional:ifdef::snapshot: `ifndef::snapshot[]..endif` -> <IfNotSnapshot> (src/components/IfNotSnapshot.tsx). Both components share useIsSnapshot() (banner==='unreleased'), so the two halves cannot disagree and show both or neither. SPLICED, so every version's MDX carries BOTH halves and a `docusaurus docs:version` cut is idempotent: the missing half is taken from a version that rendered it, only if the branch's SOURCE text is byte-identical on both, and converted with the DONOR's variable maps but the RECIPIENT's page URL (values are baked per version; link resolution depends on where the page lives). Version-cut-safe, nothing baked. VERIFIED IN THE BUILT SITE, all 4 live versions, one branch each and the right one: update-config links `hazelcast/blob/master` on 5.12-snapshot and `hazelcast/tree/v5.7.0` / `v5.6.0` / `v5.6.0` on 5.11 / 5.10 / 5.9; install installs the unpinned snapshot package on 5.12-snapshot and `hazelcast-management-center-5.11.0` / `-5.10.0` / `-5.9.0` on the releases (note install.adoc also has a SECOND, UNCONDITIONAL `debian snapshot` section of its own -- page content, not a leaked branch). SAME UPSTREAM CAVEAT AS THE IFDEF ENTRY: v/5.9's antora.yml carries a stray `snapshot: true`, so the golden renders 5.9's SNAPSHOT half while our release-half output is more correct than the live site; that is the sole cause of the 4 L1 CODE diffs on /management-center/5.9/getting-started/install, which are NOT in fidelity/accepted.json yet (an open disposition decision, unlike operator's image-registry). Gate interaction to know about: because a spliced page carries both halves while the census renders one, refcheck counts references half-for-half (hiddenBranchComponents / dropHiddenBranches). See docusaurus-conditionals-project.

notes.include:relative [x-comp]: management-center-only, ONE source line x 4 live branches (getting-started/overview.adoc:137): `include::{page-latest-supported-hazelcast}@hazelcast:deploy:versioning-compatibility.adoc[tag=supported-jvms]` -- a CROSS-COMPONENT include of another component's PAGE (no `$` family, so Antora defaults to page$), tag-sliced, at a version given by an ATTRIBUTE coordinate that Antora resolves during classification. cloud/operator/clc have none. Converted by FACTORING the slice into a per-version MDX partial (management-center[_versioned_docs/version-*]/_partials/deploy-versioning-compatibility.mdx) imported as <PartialDeployVersioningCompatibility/>. VERIFIED IN THE BUILT SITE, all 4 live versions, on two independent axes. (1) The version COORDINATE resolves per MC version rather than freezing: 5.12-snapshot and 5.11 carry the JDK-25 rows (`Amazon Corretto 17, 21 and 25`), 5.10 and 5.9 the older `17 and 21` set -- i.e. each MC version pulls its own supported Platform version's table. (2) The reference INSIDE the included region survives as <Variable name="full-version"/> instead of baking (the class-C consumer-scoped attribute fix: a factored partial's attribute scope is the union of its including pages'), rendering Platform 5.12.0-SNAPSHOT / 5.11.0 / 5.10.0 / 5.9.0 -- byte-identical to the golden on all four, and the page has ZERO rows in the fidelity failure report. UPSTREAM CAVEAT, faithfully reproduced not fixed: AsciiDoc resolves {full-version} in the INCLUDING document, so MC's copy of this table says "Platform 5.11.0" while hz-docs' own page says "Platform 5.7.0" -- and there is no Platform 5.11.x (Platform stops at 5.7/5.8-snapshot). The header should have used page-latest-supported-hazelcast. CONFIRMED on live docs.hazelcast.com (it reads 5.11.1 there; our 5.11.0 is the pinned SHA's value), so this is an upstream report, not ours to fix -- and because the reference is preserved rather than baked it stays wrong AUTOMATICALLY on a future cut, which is exactly what the golden shows. Correcting it would be a deliberate divergence plus a fidelity accept entry; not taken. See docusaurus-refcheck-gate (class C) and docusaurus-partials-preservation.
notes.inline-macro:icon:: An icon used as CONTENT, not decoration. management-center getting-started/overview holds `icon:check-circle[size=lg,role=success]` / `icon:times[size=lg,role=error]` in its Enterprise-vs-Community feature matrix -- the ticks and crosses ARE the table's data. FIXED 2026-08-18: these were being DROPPED (36 per version, every marker column blank) by the `<i> is always decoration` rule; the converter now reads the `span.icon <role>` wrapper that only a content icon carries and emits <Icon role=…> (src/components/Icon, HIVE's <Icon> + react-feather CheckCircle/XCircle, coloured from --hive-color-{success,error}-v4). Verified in the BUILT page: 24 success + 12 error, matching the golden's counts exactly, and fidelity clean. Rendered as an ICON not a ✓/✗ CHARACTER on purpose -- the golden's <i> carries no text, so a character would add content the source never rendered and fail Layer 1. Decorative <i> (admonition glyphs, external-link markers) is still dropped. An unlisted role is NOT emitted, so a new one must be added to the front-end registry first.
